figures.caption: 圖：打掃時間的教室與走廊
figures.description: 學校的打掃時間，畫面左邊是教室，右邊是走廊。教室裡，一個男生拿著掃把，把地上的紙屑掃成一小堆；他旁邊一個女生拿著拖把在拖地，腳邊放著一個水桶；靠近窗戶的地方，另一個男生舉起手，用抹布擦窗戶的玻璃。走廊上擺著三盆盆栽，一個女生拿著澆水壺在幫盆栽澆水。

questions.stem: 提示：學校每天都有打掃時間，全班同學分工合作，把教室和走廊整理乾淨。請仔細看下面的圖片，寫一篇英文作文，文分兩段。第一段描述圖中的學生們在打掃時間做哪些工作；第二段寫出你自己負責過的一項打掃工作和一次具體的經驗，並說明你最喜歡哪一種打掃工作及原因。

1.explanation_zh: 這一題有三個要求：第一段描述圖中學生在打掃時間做的工作（掃地、拖地、擦窗戶、幫盆栽澆水）；第二段寫自己負責過的一項打掃工作，並舉一次具體的經驗，最後說明最喜歡哪一種打掃工作與原因。最喜歡的工作可以和負責過的工作相同，也可以不同，但一定要有理由。
evidence: 描述圖中的學生們在打掃時間做哪些工作
寫出你自己負責過的一項打掃工作和一次具體的經驗
說明你最喜歡哪一種打掃工作及原因
1.strategy_zh: 第一段照「教室裡由左到右，再到走廊」的順序一人一句；第二段先寫負責的工作，再用一件事說明，最後用 First、Second 列出喜歡的理由。
hints: 第一段：Inside the classroom, a boy is sweeping … Out in the hallway, …
第二段：In my class, I am in charge of … 接一次經驗 After …, we …
理由：First, I can … Second, … 最後用 In short, … 回扣打掃時間

content.focus_zh: 第一段寫出圖中至少三項打掃工作（掃地、拖地、擦窗戶、澆水）；第二段要說出自己負責過的一項工作，舉一次具體的經驗（什麼時候、發生什麼），並說明最喜歡哪一種打掃工作與理由。

bands.descriptor_zh: 回應題目的每一項要求，主旨明確；用具體的事例、細節或親身經驗撐起每個重點。
大致回應題目，但有一項要求寫得單薄，或細節偏籠統、說服力不足。
漏掉題目的主要要求或主旨模糊，多數句子空泛、重複或偏離題目。
空白、離題、只抄題目，或內容少到無法判斷要說什麼。

organization.focus_zh: 第一段依位置由教室寫到走廊；第二段先寫負責的工作與經驗，再寫最喜歡的工作與理由（可用 First、Second 列出），結尾回扣打掃時間的意義。

bands.descriptor_zh: 兩段分工清楚，各有主題句；句與句、段與段的銜接自然，轉承語用得恰當，篇幅分配合理。
段落大致分明，但有的地方跳接或重複，轉承語偏少或用得生硬。
重點排列混亂，前後句常接不起來，讀者不容易跟上。
看不出段落與順序，句子彼此無關。

grammar.focus_zh: 描述圖片用現在進行式（is sweeping、is mopping）；寫過去的經驗用過去式；I have done this job since … 這類現在完成式要搭配 since 或 for。

bands.descriptor_zh: 句子幾乎沒有文法、標點錯誤，能交替使用簡單句、複句與不同的句首。
偶有時態、單複數或標點錯誤，但讀得懂意思；句型變化有限。
錯誤多到常讓人誤解意思，句子結構常不完整。
幾乎沒有正確的句子，無法理解。

vocabulary.focus_zh: 掃把、拖把、抹布、澆水壺、盆栽等說法（broom、mop、cloth、watering can、potted plant）要用對；sweep、mop、wipe、water 等動詞不要全部寫成 clean。

bands.descriptor_zh: 用字精準、貼切，搭配自然，少有重複；拼字與大小寫幾乎全對。
字彙範圍偏窄、常重複同幾個字，偶有用字不當或拼錯，但不妨礙理解。
用錯字或拼錯字很多，常讓人看不懂。
幾乎每個字都用錯或拼錯，無法理解。

rubric.deductions_zh: 字數明顯不足（少於 100 個單詞）或沒有分成兩段，各扣總分 1 分；兩種情形同時發生只扣 1 分。離題或空白以 0 分計。

sentence_starters: In my class, I am in charge of ...

model_texts.label: steady
model_texts.text:
The picture shows four students busy at cleaning time. Each of them has a different job. Inside the classroom, a boy is sweeping bits of paper into a small pile with a broom. Next to him, a girl is mopping the floor, and there is a bucket beside her. Near the window, another boy is wiping the glass with a cloth. Out in the hallway, a girl is watering three potted plants with a watering can. They are all working hard to keep their school clean.
In my class, I am in charge of wiping the windows, and I have done this job since September. At first, I thought it was boring. However, one experience changed my mind. After a typhoon last month, our windows were covered with mud and leaves. My partner and I spent the whole cleaning period washing them, so our arms were very tired. The next morning, bright sunlight came in through the clean glass, and our teacher thanked us in front of the class. Now I like wiping the windows best for two reasons. First, I can see the result right away. Second, I can chat with my partner while we work, so the time passes quickly. In short, cleaning time is not just a chore; it also makes our classroom a brighter place to study.

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 第一段寫出四個學生的工作，第二段有負責的工作、一次具體的經驗與兩個理由（內容 4）；At first、However、First、Second 讓順序清楚，但段落銜接較單純（組織 4）；時態正確，句型以簡單句和並列句為主（文法句構 4）；sweep、mop、wipe 用得正確，但整體多是常用字（字彙拼字 3）。總分 15，屬穩健版。

model_texts.label: top
model_texts.text:
When the bell rings for cleaning time, the school in the picture quickly fills with quiet teamwork. Inside the classroom, a boy is sweeping scraps of paper into a neat pile, while a girl right beside him is mopping the floor, with a bucket at her feet. Over by the window, another boy is stretching his arm up to wipe the glass with a cloth, determined to make the whole window sparkle. The calmest job, however, is taking place outside. In the hallway, a girl is watering a row of three potted plants, tipping her watering can carefully so that no water spills onto the floor. None of these tasks looks impressive on its own, but together they keep the whole school clean every single day.
In my class, cleaning jobs rotate every month, so I have tried almost all of them, but wiping the windows has become my favorite. At first, I found it tedious and even a little annoying, since the glass never seemed to stay clean for long. My attitude changed after a typhoon last October. The storm had left our windows covered with mud and dead leaves, and my partner and I spent two whole cleaning periods scrubbing them. The next morning, sunlight poured through the spotless glass, and several classmates noticed the difference before our teacher even mentioned it. Now I prefer this job to any other for two reasons. To begin with, unlike sweeping, which has to be repeated as soon as someone drops a snack wrapper, a clean window offers a visible result that lasts for days. Moreover, working in pairs turns a chore into a conversation. On a typical day, my partner and I chat about everything from exam stress to our favorite bands while we work. Admittedly, reaching the top corners is tiring, and my arms often ache afterward. Even so, I would choose this job again. All in all, it has taught me that responsibility feels lighter when the results are easy to see and the work is shared.

paragraphs.function_zh: 描述圖片：由教室寫到走廊，用 while 與 however 串起四項工作，最後點出合作的意義

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 圖片描述有位置、動作與細節，並點出合作的意義；經驗段有態度改變的經過、兩個理由與讓步，最後提出對責任的見解（內容 5）；To begin with、Moreover、Admittedly、Even so 使論述層次分明（組織 5）；過去完成式、非限定關係子句、so that 等句型正確多樣（文法句構 5）；spotless、rotate、visible 用得貼切，但整體以常用字為主（字彙拼字 4）。總分 19，屬頂標版。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段依教室到走廊寫出掃地、拖地、擦窗戶、澆水四項工作，broom、mop、cloth、watering can、potted plants 都用對；第二段寫負責擦窗戶、颱風後清泥巴的具體經驗與兩個理由，結尾回扣打掃時間的意義。全文無錯，但句型與用字偏基本，細節不算豐富。

top.comment_zh: 圖中四項工作描寫生動（stretching his arm up、tipping her watering can carefully），段尾點出團隊合作；第二段由輪值帶出最喜歡擦窗戶，颱風後的經驗具體，兩個理由有對比（unlike sweeping）並含讓步（Admittedly … Even so），句型多變、用字精準，無錯誤。第二段篇幅明顯較長，但仍合理。

steady.comment_zh: 兩段分明。第一段由教室寫到走廊，四項工作（掃地、拖地、擦窗戶、澆水）都寫到且與圖相符；第二段說出自己負責擦窗戶、颱風後清洗泥巴的具體經驗，並用 First、Second 說明最喜歡的理由，結尾回扣打掃時間的意義。時態與 since 用法正確，句型以簡單句與簡單複句為主；用字準確（broom、mop、cloth、watering can、potted plants），範圍中等。

top.comment_zh: 第一段依位置完整描述四項工作且細節生動；第二段交代輪值背景、颱風後兩節課擦窗的具體經驗，再用 To begin with、Moreover、Admittedly、Even so 排列理由與讓步，結尾回扣責任與合作。現在進行式、過去式、現在完成式皆正確，句型變化豐富；用字精準多樣（scraps、sparkle、tedious、spotless）。小瑕疵：先說玻璃不易保持乾淨，後說成果可維持數日，前後略有張力，但不影響整體。
